name: Companion: Beast of the Sky
desc: Flying companion (hawk, owl, etc.). AC 13 + your Wisdom modifier, Hit Points 4 + 4 × your Ranger level, Speed 10 feet, Fly 60 feet. Beast's Strike: your spell attack modifier, reach 5 feet, 1d4 + 3 + your Wisdom modifier; it doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies away (Flyby).
